data.long_meaning: Chandraanan is derived from Chandra, meaning 'Moon'. The suffix 'anan' means 'God'. This name is a tribute to the Moon God, evoking feelings of peace, tranquility, and divine protection. The name Chandraanan carries the meaning “Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandraanan usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
